name: Ch.1 · A Voice Beneath the Palm
gameInstructions: Help Deborah answer with fairness. Choose the response that brings truth and peace.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Israel had forgotten the ways of peace, and fear lay over the land.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Yet beneath a palm tree in the hills of Ephraim sat Deborah—a prophet, a judge, and a listener.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: People came to her with tangled troubles, and she answered with wisdom and courage.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Israelites went up to her to have their disputes decided.
